_note: BEHAVIORAL GATE for the SINGLE-TURN CARD WRITER. Every case runs the real card path: retrieveForCard-equivalent routing (context-free hybrid retrieval, topK 4, isOffDomain) -> buildCardPrompt (@hiraia/shared prompts/cards.ts) -> llama-server at CARD_TEMP with the shared CARD_STOP sequences and chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking:false} -> sanitizeCardAnswer. ZERO TOLERANCE: there is no 'pending' flag. A case is blocking or it is deleted.

_fields.id: stable case id (also the CASES= substring filter)
_fields.lang: tagalog | cebuano | english — the card language AND the retrieval language
_fields.grade: grade the card is pitched at; interpolated into the prompt
_fields.query: exactly what the child types into the feed's ask box
_fields.expectOutcome: grounded (default) | gap | offdomain — the three card shapes. gap/offdomain are MODEL-FREE: the case asserts the routing and stops.
_fields.expectRetrieves: a fact id that MUST be in the retrieved set
_fields.mustRetrieveIdIncludes: at least one retrieved id must contain one of these substrings
_fields.mustContain: case-insensitive regexes the printed card must match (every sample)
_fields.mustNotContain: case-insensitive regexes the printed card must NOT match (every sample)
_fields.maxWords: word ceiling override; default is the prompt's own 30
_fields.gradePairWith: also print this card at that grade and compare register
_fields.samples: override the sample count for this case
_fields.skipGeneration: assert routing only, do not print a card

_universal: Assertions applied to EVERY printed card, from finetuning/eval/cardshape.mts, so they are never forgotten on a new case: generation health (non-empty content — the thinking-model trap — and finish_reason 'stop', not 'length' — the repetition trap), a printable sanitizeCardAnswer, the 30-word / 320-char ceiling, no greeting, no preamble or prompt-cue echo, no question mark, no invitation to keep talking, no deflection, no markdown scaffolding (bold, code fences, bullets, headings) or repeated sentence, no [image:] tag, no emoji, language purity in all three directions, and GROUNDEDNESS (the card must share at least one content word with a retrieved fact — a card written from parametric memory fails even when it dodges every mustNotContain). Two further defects are asserted on the RAW generation, before sanitizeCardAnswer: a leaked reasoning tag and an emitted [image:] token, both of which the product sanitizer now strips.
_deleted: chitchat-ready, chitchat-hello, gibberish-unintelligible, tier2-math-offdomain, emoji-chitchat, emoji-grounded, longctx-multiturn, image-trex, image-plant-parts, image-water-cycle, image-human-heart, image-request-trex, image-request-heart, image-request-ceb-butanding, image-request-popculture-no-tag. The chat cases go with the chat surface. The image-emission cases were structurally unsatisfiable: packages/shared/src/prompts/system.ts:168 is literally `void imageTags;` with no production callers, so the gate was passing imageTags=true into a discarded parameter — image selection is retrieval + LaBSE, not the model. gibberish-unintelligible is now route-offdomain-gibberish: a keyboard mash gets the off-domain CARD, not a model apology.

cases.query: totoo po bang patag ang mundo?
cases._was_pending: 'patag' is semantically opposite to round-earth facts (cos 0.49) so retrieval abstained and the model had nothing to affirm from. BLOCKING now.
cases._note_2026_09_02: FIXED retrieval-side: 'patag' added to earth-shape-oblate-spheroid-g7 terms (its tl body literally says 'halos bilog ... patag sa magkabilang dulo'), so the query now grounds on the real shape fact (lex #1, fused #1). allowUngrounded kept as the safety net for the razor-thin cosine (0.532 vs floor 0.53).
cases._why_allowUngrounded: The ONLY case exempt from the universal groundedness check, and it is exempt because its mustContain demands the opposite. Measured: this query retrieves fe-del-mundo-incubator-g6, earth-has-one-moon-g4, fe-del-mundo-pediatrician-g5 — nothing about the shape of the Earth, because 'patag' embeds AWAY from every round-earth fact. The card the case requires ('Hindi totoo na patag ang mundo — ito ay bilog') therefore shares almost no vocabulary with what was retrieved and would be flagged as parametric invention. It IS parametric, and here that is correct: telling a child the Earth might be flat because the retriever missed is worse than an ungrounded card. Do not copy this flag onto a case that is merely failing.

cases._was_pending: Deflected ('tanungin ang doktor') — no smoking-harm fact retrieved. BLOCKING now; the universal no-deflection rule covers the punt, this asserts the substance.

cases._codified_from: Tier-2: printed a disturbing non-sequitur to a child ('walang gustong kumain ng sarili nilang utak'). This is now a ROUTING case, because that card can only be printed if the query reaches the model — and it does not.
cases._measured: MEASURED on this bank + the gate's own Q4_K_M LaBSE: topCos 0.467, lexEmpty false, unreachable false, retrieval returns NOTHING -> the model-free gap card. (The old note here claimed 0.942 on a thermostat card; that number is not reproducible against this bank/embedder and has been removed.) The case previously carried no expectOutcome, so it defaulted to 'grounded' and was PERMANENTLY red on routing, which also meant its five mustNotContain guards could never run — run-eval only generates when expectOutcome AND outcome are both 'grounded'. Those guards are deleted rather than left as decoration: with no generation there is nothing for them to assert.
cases._open: On the merits chitchat arguably deserves the OFF-DOMAIN card ('I am only a science tutor') rather than the in-domain gap card. It cannot get there today: isOffDomain needs topCos < 0.40 (hard floor) or lexical unreachability, and this query is 0.467 and lexically reachable. Asserting 'offdomain' here would encode a permanently-red case, so the gate asserts what the product does and the product question is left open. What this case DOES protect is the thing that hurt a child: chitchat must never reach the model.

cases._why: The canonical invention trigger, documented in prompts/cards.ts: it clears EVERY gate ('final' is in the bank so it is not lexically empty, and it scores .630) and arrives at the model with four SHARK facts. The prompt's only permitted escape is 'print the nearest FACT whole — do not force the connection'. Forcing it (a shark card that pretends to be about basketball) is the failure.
cases._why_mustContain: mustNotContain alone was not enough: the card 'Ang finals ay ang pinakahuling laban ng isang serye ng paligsahan' PASSED — a definition invented from parametric memory that simply avoided all seven forbidden words. So the escape the _why describes is now asserted POSITIVELY: the card has to name something that was actually retrieved. Subjects are those of the measured top-4 (shark / morning-glory vine / Supreme Court / soap micelle); if the bank moves, re-measure and update them.

cases._why: Same probe in the Cebuano vector space — the bis rows are a different half of the blob, so the fusion that hands over four shark facts is a different fusion.
cases._why_mustContain: Same positive-groundedness assertion as the Tagalog twin. Subjects are those of the measured Cebuano top-4 (shark / lymph node / Supreme Court / millipede); re-measure if the bank moves.

cases.query: ano po ang pangalan ng pinakamalaking bituin sa buong universe?
cases._why: The APP-PATH half of abstain-biggest-star, kept SEPARATE from the model probe rather than replacing it. It pins where the routing lands: this is science with retrievable neighbours, so it is GROUNDED and reaches the model. There is no gap card waiting to catch a bad answer here — which is precisely why the model probe next door has to be blocking.

Grade is a user-visible setting interpolated straight into the card prompt, and NOTHING asserted it changed anything. Runs the same query at Grade 3 and Grade 10 and requires (a) both are valid cards, (b) they DIFFER — an inert grade is a silent broken setting — and (c) the register does not INVERT (the Grade-3 card is not the wordier, longer-worded one).
